title: Resident Handbook — Storage Units in the Final Month: The Independent Living Closing Amount
content:
The final month's rented storage units add to the closing amount of an Independent Living Residency Agreement at the monthly storage rent per unit, 45.00 for every apartment type, the number of units being the quantity on the latest storage unit charge (latest by service date).

| Latest storage unit charge | Storage added to the closing amount |
|---|---|
| Quantity of two or more | 45.00 once for each unit |
| Quantity of one | 45.00 once |
| No storage unit charge | No storage amount |

The rent is a whole month's rent per unit, without proration.

Hypothetical cases: a resident whose latest storage unit charge carries a quantity of 2 adds 90.00 to the closing amount; a resident in an apartment type that includes a storage unit and rents no further unit, so that no storage unit charge appears on the ledger, adds nothing.
